description: Manage Zscaler Internet Access: URL categories, the allow and deny lists, URL filtering rules and activation, look up users and URLs, and start workflows when users, rules or pending changes appear.

zscaler_changes_pending_activation_trigg.description: Runs when changes are saved in Zscaler and wait to be activated. It runs again the next time, once those have been activated. Changes saved and activated between two checks aren't seen. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

zscaler_firewall_rule_changed_trigger.description: Runs for each firewall rule added or changed in Zscaler. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.action: What the rule does, such as ALLOW or BLOCK.
output.last_modified_by: The admin who last changed it.
output.last_modified_time: When it last changed, in seconds since 1970.
output.name: The firewall rule's name.
output.order: Where the rule sits in the rule order.
output.rule: The whole firewall rule as Zscaler gives it.

zscaler_new_department_trigger.description: Runs for each new department in Zscaler. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 10,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.department: The whole department as Zscaler gives it.
output.name: The department's name.

zscaler_new_group_trigger.description: Runs for each new group in Zscaler. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 10,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.group: The whole group as Zscaler gives it.
output.name: The group's name.

zscaler_new_location_trigger.description: Runs for each new location in Zscaler. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 10,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.location: The whole location as Zscaler gives it.
output.name: The location's name.

zscaler_new_url_category_trigger.description: Runs for each new custom URL category in Zscaler. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.category: The whole URL category as Zscaler gives it.
output.id: The category's id, such as CUSTOM_01, for the URL category steps.
output.name: The category's name.

zscaler_new_user_trigger.description: Runs for each new user in Zscaler. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 10,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.department: The name of the user's department.
output.groups: The names of the groups the user is in.
output.name: The user's name.
output.user: The whole user as Zscaler gives it.

zscaler_url_filtering_rule_changed_trigg.description: Runs for each URL filtering rule added or changed in Zscaler. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
zscaler_url_filtering_rule_changed_trigg.display_name: New or updated URL filtering rule

output.action: What the rule does, such as ALLOW or BLOCK.
output.last_modified_by: The admin who last changed it.
output.last_modified_time: When it last changed, in seconds since 1970.
output.name: The URL filtering rule's name.
output.order: Where the rule sits in the rule order.
output.rule: The whole URL filtering rule as Zscaler gives it.
